name: python-levenshtein
title: Levenshtein Distance
blurb: Unit-cost edit distance over lowercase strings: the row walk equals a shipped exponential oracle on short pairs, reads the same from either side, never beats a detour, and nearest equals the scan's argmin with ties first by letters.
default_description: Unit-cost edit distance over lowercase strings whose row walk equals a bare recursion on short pairs and whose nearest equals the scan's argmin.
